title: T007 — invalid modifier for format
purpose: Applying a format-specific modifier (e.g. fixed-width :pos / :len) to a target that does not support it.
trigger: :pos and :len are fixed-width positioning modifiers but the target format is json.
fix: Drop the fixed-width modifiers for JSON output, or switch the target format to fixed-width.
notes: Reported as a T007 warning, one per incompatible modifier: 'Modifier ':pos' is not applicable to format 'json' and will be ignored'.
The transform still succeeds; the offending modifiers are dropped from the output.
